title: Penn Museum oracle bone object records
provider: University of Pennsylvania Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology
scope: Official Penn Museum object record for oracle bone 49-14-7A with object number, Anyang provenience, Shang Dynasty period, material, dimensions, display location, and credit line.
download_strategy: Use as an object-level university museum provenance and collection metadata source; do not treat museum display text as a paleographic decipherment authority.
risk_note: Official university museum object page; image and rights reuse require object-level review before raw asset import.
research_boundary: source_object_packet_preprocessing_only; source metadata, routes, download logs, package manifests, and field maps are not decipherment, identity, component, inscription, or correspondence conclusions
